title: Sepo v0.4.0: More interactive, more responsive!
body:
## What's Changed * Bundle model defaults in .agent/model-defaults.json (simpler alternative to #393) by @lolipopshock in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/401 * Use Markdown issue templates for Ask and Install Sepo by @sepo-agent-app[bot] in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/405 * Add explicit .agent test lanes by @sepo-agent-app[bot] in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/414 * Pin Claude ACPX models via ANTHROPIC_MODEL (fix resume crash on date-pinned IDs) by @lolipopshock in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/415 * Add proposal-based rubrics route by @sepo-agent-app[bot] in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/425 * Add post-job cleanup hook to self-hosted runner setup by @lolipopshock in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/419 * Live agent progress comment with 👎-to-cancel by @lolipopshock @ryanyen2 in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/429 * Add on-demand GitHub attachment downloader CLI by @sepo-agent-app[bot] in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/431 * Skip empty rubrics review runs by @sepo-agent-app[bot] in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/412 * Prepare Sepo 0.4.0 release by @sepo-agent-app[bot] in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/433 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/compare/v0.3.1...v0.4.0
This discussion was created from the release Sepo v0.4.0: More interactive, more responsive!.
